description: Read the characters in a locale file rather than its structure. Reports a bidirectional control character, which is invisible in every editor and reorders everything after it including text nobody touched; a zero-width character, which still counts toward a length limit; text not in NFC form, which compares unequal to the same text typed differently; and markup appearing only in a translation, where the call site was written for plain text. Pay 170000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

allow_html.description: Permit markup where the base string also has it. Markup appearing only in a translation is still reported. Defaults to false.

locales.description: The locale files to scan. One entry per locale. Exactly one may be marked as the base; when none is, the first supplied is used and that is reported.

base.description: Whether this is the source locale the others are compared against.

locale.description: A language tag such as en, pt-BR or ar.

messages.description: This locale’s messages. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

name: locale_text_safety_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

locales.description: Per locale: message count and how many carried a bidi control, a zero-width character or markup.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

safe.description: True only when nothing above applied across every message scanned.

title: Locale Text Safety Audit
